replace.title: Pārvatī and the Visitor Who Questioned Her Choice
replace.hook: An aged ascetic comes to Pārvatī's place of tapas and questions why she seeks Śiva. She answers what he cannot see in Śiva's outward form, then discovers who has come to visit.

source: Śiva Purāṇa, Rudra-saṃhitā, Pārvatī-khaṇḍa 26.1–8 and 27–28; the visitor is explicitly a very old man, not a boy.
